description: Partial details of part (i) of condition 7 (Construction Logistics Plans) and part (i) of condition 8 (Construction and Environmental Management Plans), in relation to the demolition and piling mat works at 1 Minerva Road only; partial details of parts (ii) and (iii) of condition 7 (Construction Logistics Plans) and parts (ii) and (iii) of condition 8 (Construction and Environmental Management Plans), in relation to the installation of the buried pipework along Minerva Road and North Acton Road only; and Partial details of condition 11 (HS2 Safeguarding), in relation to 1 Minerva Road and works along Minerva Road and North Acton Road only; pursuant to planning permission reference 25/0184/FUMOPDC dated 25/03/2026, for 'Development associated with the Old Oak and Park Royal Energy Network (OPEN) district heating network, comprising: Demolition of a warehouse building at 1 Minerva Road, London, NW10 6HJ, and erection of a purpose built energy centre building; Laying of a network of underground heat pipes; Erection of a crossover gantry to carry the pipework over existing railway tracks, running parallel to the Park Royal Road Overbridge; and Other associated works.' (Out of Borough from Old Oak and Park Royal Development Corporation)
